method: Simon preferential attachment with open vocabulary, seed 14047. At each of 14,400 slots, invent the next numbered symbol with probability 0.6, otherwise select uniformly among all earlier token occurrences and repeat that spelling. Render each index in base six using a,o,d,e,i,y and put q and r at its ends. This is a meaningless and unbounded naming procedure; there are no manuscript phrases or fitted type frequencies. Line breaks every nine words are packaging. It tests whether continual word invention plus popularity-based reuse is sufficient to produce the singleton share, unlike the earlier line-restarting glyph-chain attack.
